opening: I usually follow the same route to enter and exit the school campus. There are no staircases nearby but I often use the stairs. Why?
answer: There is a pair of escalators connecting the campus. I must take the escalator to get to the campus since there are no staircases nearby. One of these escalators is often under maintenance. When this happens, the other escalator will be paused so that people can use it as a staircase to enter and exit the campus.
